assignment: PlatoTab — Regenerate button visibility for NON-STALE current reviews (SPEC 2.5), Regenerate ConfirmationModal open + CANCEL only, noResume empty state. Display only; no confirm.
steps: Navigated to http://app.lvh.me:5007/jobs — already logged in as Rezu May (Acme Inc.). Clicked 'Senior Engineer' → candidates view opened on Inbox / Agnes Sipes (20977).

Clicked the Plato tab (…/applicants/20977/ai). Review renders: 'Generated by Plato · about 1 hour ago', fit chip 'Poor fit', headline h1 'Seeded review — early-career QA, weak fit', analysis paragraph 'Seeded fixture analysis: early-career QA analyst without software engineering or Android development experience; remote-only preference conflicts with the relocation requirement. Weak alignment.', scoring detail 5 criteria (0/0/5).

SPEC 2.5 CORE CHECK — Regenerate button IS present in the tab's header-right for this NON-STALE current review. Accessibility snapshot showed the button without a name; DOM inspection confirmed button text 'Regenerate' with span class 'PlatoTab_Styled-ButtonLabel-PlatoTab_ButtonLabel' (icon svg + label), enabled (disabled=false). PASS — pre-feature this rendered only for stale reviews; PlatoTab console debug log confirms statusValue: current, fullSummaryStatus: succeeded (summary 2531), and the seeded review is non-stale.

Clicked Regenerate → ConfirmationModal opened. VERBATIM copy — title: 'Are you sure you want to regenerate?'; body paragraph (single

with

between sentences): 'Regenerating runs a fresh analysis of this candidate and replaces the existing review. Uses 1 credit of 20 remaining.' + 'Recommended when the resume has been updated or the job description has changed.'; buttons: 'Regenerate', 'Cancel'. Credit-consumption sentence present; displayed balance 20 = seeded starting balance (no prior agent runs had landed).

Clicked Cancel → modal closed (confirm-title element gone from DOM). Network check: requests matching ai_job_application_summar are ONLY GETs — [GET] /api/v1/job_applications/20977/ai_job_application_summaries/2531 => 200 and later [GET] /api/v1/job_applications/20976/ai_job_application_summaries/2530 => 200. ZERO POSTs to ai_job_application_summaries in the whole session — Cancel fired nothing.

Second Inbox candidate: clicked Carl Dietrich (20976) — Plato tab stayed selected (…/20976/ai). Review renders: h1 'Seeded review — backend profile, light mobile exposure', list-row chip 'Good fit'; Regenerate button present and enabled in header-right. PASS.

noResume state: clicked Screen stage (5) → clicked bare candidate Brent Lubowitz (20982, no fit chip) → Plato tab. Empty state VERBATIM: title 'Plato needs a resume', body 'Upload a resume on the resume tab, then come back to generate a review.', single CTA button 'Go to resume tab' (enabled). NO Regenerate button anywhere on the page (DOM-wide scan). PlatoTab debug log confirms statusValue: none.
Step-6 CTA note: bare (no-resume) candidates get NO Generate button — the empty-state CTA is 'Go to resume tab' only. Not clicked.

Console check across the whole session: 0 error-level messages per browser_console_messages(all). Page-level [ERROR] lines in the session log are all known noise: react-router history deprecation warnings, 'Store does not have a valid reducer', heap-api.com 404, plus an emotion ':first-child is potentially unsafe when doing server-side rendering' vendor-chunk warning (pre-existing, not feature-referencing). No rescore/BulkGenerateAiSummaries/PlatoTab/ai_job_application_summaries errors, no React errors.

findings.title: Report-only: Agnes Sipes (Poor fit review) shows no fit chip in the Inbox candidate-list row while Carl Dietrich (Good fit) and Emilee Hand (Excellent fit) rows show theirs
findings.expected: If list rows show a fit chip for candidates with a current review, all three seeded Inbox candidates would show one (Agnes' PlatoTab review is 'Poor fit').
findings.actual: Inbox list: Agnes Sipes row has no chip; Carl Dietrich row shows 'Good fit'; Emilee Hand row shows 'Excellent fit'. Agnes' Plato tab and Overview both render her Poor-fit review normally.
findings.evidence: Accessibility snapshot of the Inbox list (links 20977/20976/20975); outside this agent's assigned scope (list chips are not SPEC 2.5), reported as observation only — may be an intentional rule for Poor fit or a fixture/denormalization artifact.

findings.title: Nitpick: '[PlatoTab] render' debug console.log fires on every PlatoTab render (logs jobApplicationId, statusValue, fullSummaryStatus)
findings.expected: No component-level debug logging, or logging consistent with an intentional dev-only pattern.
findings.actual: Console LOG '%c[PlatoTab] render {jobApplicationId: …, statusValue: …, fullSummaryStatus: …}' on every render, in the packs-test bundle. Matches the formatting of the pre-existing '[queryHooks] apiGet' debug logs, so it may be intentional dev instrumentation; noting in case it was left over from this feature's development.
